chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Crossing paths with the Ritz Brothers, Marx Brothers and others
summary: Asked about future stars met in vaudeville he names Tony DeMarco, the Ritz and Marx Brothers but recalls no stories.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Through vaudeville you were running into a lot of subsequently famous people like Burns and Allen, like Bob Hope -- people like that, is that correct?
Did you have any relations with these people? Did you know them intimately or --
No, I had that with Tony DeMarco and Sally -- and what's that last name -- I forgot her last name. However, Tony DeMarco and Ritz Brothers and --
Marx Brothers, bumped into them, too. Marx Brothers and --

Did you have any particular experiences that you want to relate about having bumped into these people or something that happened with any of these particular people that happen to stick out in your mind?
I don't know of any. I'm trying to think of -- can't think of nothing.
